name: 02-sched-too-soon
derived: the first request again, from host 1 with rpc_seqno one higher, sent at once: a client that asks for work again before min_sendwork_interval has passed

name: 03-sched-too-soon-listed
derived: the request before with its task listed under other_results, so that nothing is lost and the server comes to the check of min_sendwork_interval

name: 04-sched-forgot-jobs-left
derived: the second request again, after the wait, with three jobs still unsent: the lost task is resent, and upstream sends nothing more
